timing_definition: Worker wall seconds only; setup and evaluator replay excluded; 480-second cap per attempt.
display_rounding: Nearest whole second for poster; retain unrounded values here.

layout.heading: Checked outcomes
layout.caption: Worker time only; setup and evaluator replay are separate. Replay used a fresh checkout on the same host.
rules: Use separate per-arm correctness and replay labels; never infer one from the other.
Use Pending for stages without an assessment, Failed only for a failed check, and Not attempted for an unattempted check.
Keep the lower Limits of this study callout and all source links.
No color-only status encoding, aggregate score, percentage benefit, or causal efficacy headline.
Shorten text if needed; preserve the minimum 32 CSS px / 24 pt font floor.
Rebuild and inspect layout after all stage data are complete; do not treat the earlier PDF as current.
